item.title: Stocks, Bonds Rally After US Vote as Dollar Falls: Markets Wrap
item.description: A Democratic sweep of Congress rippled across global markets, with stocks rallying after President Donald Trump accepted the result while bond yields and the dollar fell on expectations of greater limits on his agenda.
item.dc:creator: Andre Janse van Vuuren and Rose Henderson

item.title: Stock Bulls Are Glad This Election Is Finally Over
item.description: Equities, bonds rally now that the political countours are clear.
item.dc:creator: Phil Serafino

item.title: Copper Follows Stock Markets Higher as Democrats Sweep Congress
item.description: Copper climbed as stock markets turned higher and the dollar dropped after US midterm elections that saw the Democrats sweep Congress.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: India Coffee Output to Miss Forecast After Below-Normal Rains
item.description: India’s coffee output is likely to fall short of an earlier forecast as below-normal rains during the four-month monsoon season took a toll on crops, according to the Coffee Board.
item.dc:creator: Abhishek Shanker and Pratik Parija

item.title: Swiss Pharmaceutical Industry Loses Ground in Global Innovation Race
item.description: Innovation in Switzerland’s pharmaceutical industry has fallen for the second year in a row, a new study shows, underscoring how it is trailing foreign competitors in digital research and clinical trials.
item.dc:creator: Fabienne Kinzelmann

item.title: Asia Stocks Erase Early Losses as AI Worries Subside
item.description: Asian stocks recovered almost all early losses Wednesday as concerns surrounding the global artificial intelligence trade eased.
item.dc:creator: Faseeh Mangi and Winnie Hsu

item.title: US Stock Futures Rebound as Election Uncertainty Evaporates
item.description: US equity index futures rallied, reversing earlier losses, after the Democrats swept to power in Congress and President Donald Trump said he would accept the results, easing uncertainty and prompting investors to buy the recent dip in stocks.
item.dc:creator: Geoffrey Morgan, Natalia Kniazhevich and Olivia Levieux

item.title: European Stocks Rise After Midterms as Renewables and Banks Jump
item.description: European stocks extended gains after Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress in the US midterms, with renewables and banks outperforming.
item.dc:creator: Farah Elbahrawy and Levin Stamm

item.title: Musk’s Tesla, SpaceX Slide as Democrats Sweep Congress
item.description: Shares of Elon Musk’s Tesla Inc. and Space Exploration Technologies Corp. fell ahead of Wednesday’s US stock-market opening as Democrats swept to control of Congress, sharpening investor concern over the future of the Republican megadonor’s key holdings.
item.dc:creator: Jordan Fitzgerald and Subrat Patnaik

item.title: India’s Consumer Spending Boom Comes With Growing Debt Bill
item.description: When 25-year-old restaurant worker Navjot Singh wanted an iPhone he couldn’t afford on his monthly salary of 50,000 Indian rupees ($521), taking out a small loan made the purchase possible. A PlayStation and television set followed, along with loans for a wine and spirits course and a trip home.
item.dc:creator: Ruchi Bhatia and Anup Roy
